boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on nearby Daytona Beach corridors, each with one documented reason to go.

cards.title: Take a track tour
cards.subtitle: W. International Speedway Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Book a Speedway Tour from the Ticket & Tours Building to see the venue by open-air tram; check the current modified and unavailable dates first.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled behind-the-scenes motorsports stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The official tour page says daily Speedway Tours include a behind-the-scenes visit, with tour routes subject to track activity and event preparation.
cards.source_title: Daytona International Speedway Tours
cards.access_notes: Tours require a ticket; the official page says availability and routes can change with track operations.

cards.title: Browse the motorsports-adjacent plaza
cards.subtitle: W. International Speedway Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Use the plaza beside the Speedway as a daytime stop for its retail, dining, and entertainment mix; confirm individual tenant access before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A mixed-use stop directly beside the Speedway.
cards.evidence_claim: Daytona International Speedway identifies ONE DAYTONA as an area epicenter for retail, dining, and entertainment.
cards.source_title: Daytona International Speedway Official Hotel & Travel Partners
cards.access_notes: Public plaza access is generally separate from individual tenant purchases and hours.

cards.title: Make it a practical indoor errand stop
cards.subtitle: W. International Speedway Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Check the mall directory before visiting, then combine a needed retail errand with a walk through the enclosed shopping center near campus.
cards.short_summary: An enclosed retail destination near the International Speedway corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Volusia Mall’s official site provides its Daytona Beach shopping directory and visitor information.
cards.source_title: Volusia Mall
cards.access_notes: Individual stores set their own hours and purchase requirements.

cards.title: Pair art with a planetarium program
cards.subtitle: S. Nova Road corridor
cards.notes: Review the museum’s current exhibitions and planetarium schedule, then plan one focused visit instead of trying to cover every gallery at once.
cards.short_summary: A museum campus with art, science, and planetarium programming.
cards.evidence_claim: MOAS identifies its Museum of Arts & Sciences, Cici & Hyatt Brown Museum of Art, and Lowell & Nancy Lohman Planetarium programming.
cards.source_title: Museum of Arts & Sciences
cards.access_notes: Admission and special-program access may vary; review the museum’s current visit information.

cards.entity_name: African American Museum of the Arts
cards.title: See the rotating visual-art exhibitions
cards.subtitle: S. Nova Road corridor
cards.notes: Look for the current exhibition before you go, then allow time for the permanent artifacts and the rotating visual-art gallery in the same visit.
cards.short_summary: A cultural museum centered on African and African American art.
cards.evidence_claim: Daytona Beach’s heritage guide describes the museum’s permanent African-art gallery, rotating visual-art exhibitions, and collection of more than 150 artifacts.
cards.source_title: Florida African American Heritage in Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Confirm current exhibition and visitor details with the museum before travel.

cards.title: Walk the Halifax River trail
cards.subtitle: Beach Street corridor
cards.notes: Start near Magnolia Avenue and follow the waterfront running trail at your own pace; pause at the benches and swings facing the Halifax River.
cards.short_summary: A mile-long riverfront park and botanical setting.
cards.evidence_claim: The destination listing says Riverfront Esplanade spans a mile of Intracoastal waterway and includes a waterfront running trail, benches, and swings overlooking the Halifax River.
cards.source_title: Riverfront Esplanade
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is weather-dependent; use the listed Magnolia Avenue and Beach Street location.

cards.title: Read the civil-rights history on site
cards.subtitle: E. Orange Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Visit the statue and historical markers outside the ballpark, then check whether a game, museum visit, or appointment-only group tour fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: A historic ballpark with Robinson-related interpretation.
cards.evidence_claim: The destination listing says Jackie Robinson played his first integrated Major League Baseball spring-training game there in 1946 and notes the statue, markers, and museum.
cards.source_title: Jackie Robinson Ballpark and Statue
cards.access_notes: Group tours are available by appointment; games and interior access have separate schedules.

cards.title: Walk to the fishing end
cards.subtitle: Main Street and Boardwalk corridor
cards.notes: Use the pier for a daytime ocean walk, and check current conditions before planning fishing from the east end of this Main Street landmark.
cards.short_summary: A historic boardwalk pier with free fishing access when open.
cards.evidence_claim: The official listing says the pier is open every day and that its east end is normally open for fishing from dawn to dusk at no cost and without a fishing license, weather permitting.
cards.source_title: Daytona Beach Pier
cards.access_notes: Fishing access is normally dawn to dusk and weather-dependent; check for repair closures before visiting.

cards.title: Cool off at the splash pad
cards.subtitle: S. Atlantic Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan this as a daytime beachside pause between March and November, using the splash pad, shaded playground, showers, and beach-access ramps.
cards.short_summary: A beachside park with a 42-jet seasonal splash pad.
cards.evidence_claim: The official listing says Sun Splash Park has a 3,500-square-foot splash pad with 42 water jets and is open daily from 8 a.m. to sunset March 1 through November 30.
cards.source_title: Sun Splash Park
cards.access_notes: The splash pad’s stated season is March 1–November 30, daily from 8 a.m. to sunset.

cards.title: Catch a free summer concert
cards.subtitle: Oceanfront Park and N. Atlantic Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Check the current summer lineup, then arrive for a Friday or Saturday concert at the historic oceanfront Bandshell; reserved VIP seating is optional.
cards.short_summary: A historic oceanfront amphitheater with a free summer concert series.
cards.evidence_claim: The official visitor page says 2026 summer concerts at the Bandshell are free to the public, with optional reserved VIP tickets.
cards.source_title: Daytona Beach Bandshell Summer Concerts & Fireworks
cards.access_notes: The 2026 listing gives Friday and Saturday concert dates and a 7:15 p.m. start; VIP seating is optional.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach rituals and recurring campus celebrations, from a paintable Spirit Rock to aviation-themed contests.

cards.title: Leave a message on the Spirit Rock
cards.subtitle: Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach campus
cards.notes: Reserve a painting slot, follow the posted content guidelines, and use the rock to share a respectful school-spirit message.
cards.short_summary: A campus-sanctioned, student-painted forum for spirit and expression.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle identifies the Spirit Rock as a valued Daytona Beach campus tradition and provides student painting guidelines.
cards.source_title: Spirit Rock | Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Use the Spirit Rock registration and guidelines on the university CampusGroups page before painting.

cards.title: Join the Orientation Class Photo
cards.subtitle: New Student Orientation, Daytona Beach
cards.notes: Find your class-year image after orientation, download the high-resolution file, and keep it as a record of joining the Eagle community.
cards.short_summary: An annual first-year group portrait preserved across graduating classes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Daytona Beach Orientation office calls its annual official Orientation Class Photo a tradition connecting students, parents and alumni.
cards.source_title: Class Photo | New Student Orientation, Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Orientation programming is for participating new students; past class photos are available to view and download online.

cards.title: Show up for Blue & Gold Week
cards.subtitle: Annual Daytona Beach spirit week
cards.notes: Check the current schedule, choose a few campus events, and use the week as a practical way to take part in Blue and Gold pride.
cards.short_summary: Embry-Riddle’s annual campus-wide spirit-week tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle’s Daytona Beach Blue & Gold Week page describes a campus spirit week celebrating university spirit and student passions.
cards.source_title: Blue & Gold Week 2026 | Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Dates, locations and registration details vary by year; consult the current Blue & Gold Week schedule.

cards.title: Make the Blue & Gold Carnival your anchor event
cards.subtitle: Blue & Gold Week, Columbia Lot
cards.notes: Use the Blue & Gold Week schedule to confirm the carnival date and location, then build your visit around the larger spirit-week program.
cards.short_summary: A named carnival that opens Blue & Gold Week’s celebratory rhythm.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026 Blue & Gold Week schedule lists the Blue & Gold Carnival as a featured campus event in Columbia Lot.
cards.source_title: Blue & Gold Week 2026 | Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Confirm annual timing and event entry details through the Blue & Gold Week schedule.

cards.title: Watch or enter Pull-A-Plane
cards.subtitle: Blue & Gold Week, AMS Ramp
cards.notes: Look for team and participation details in the current Blue & Gold Week listings, then head to the AMS Ramp at the scheduled time.
cards.short_summary: An aviation-specific strength challenge staged during spirit week.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle’s 2026 Blue & Gold Week schedule lists Pull-A-Plane at the AMS Ramp.
cards.source_title: Blue & Gold Week 2026 | Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Participation rules and scheduling are event-specific; verify them with the current Blue & Gold Week listing.

cards.title: Add color at the Chalk Art Contest
cards.subtitle: Blue & Gold Week, Legacy Walk
cards.notes: Bring your creativity to Legacy Walk during the posted contest window, and check the event listing for any entry or material requirements.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled campus-art ritual set along Legacy Walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2026 Blue & Gold Week schedule lists a Chalk Art Contest on Legacy Walk, sponsored by Student Engagement and the Student Union.
cards.source_title: Blue & Gold Week 2026 | Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Consult the current schedule for the contest time, registration and participation instructions.

cards.title: Gather at the Blue & Gold Block Party
cards.subtitle: Blue & Gold Week, Connolly Quad
cards.notes: Use the annual schedule to verify the theme and timing, then meet at Connolly Quad for this Student Government Association program.
cards.short_summary: A named spirit-week gathering in the campus quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle’s 2026 Blue & Gold Week schedule lists a Blue & Gold Block Party at Connolly Quad, sponsored by Student Government Association.
cards.source_title: Blue & Gold Week 2026 | Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: Themes and timing change by year; verify the current Blue & Gold Week schedule before attending.

cards.title: Come back for Homecoming & Family Weekend
cards.subtitle: Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach campus
cards.notes: Register when the annual event opens, then use the released schedule to select campus tours, athletics and community programs that fit your visit.
cards.short_summary: An annual return-to-campus gathering connecting students, families and alumni.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle says Daytona Beach Homecoming & Family Weekend occurs each year and connects students, alumni, parents and families through campus events.
cards.source_title: Current Eagle Parents | Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University
cards.access_notes: Registration and programming are annual; the 2026 event is scheduled for October 2-3 on the Daytona Beach campus.

cards.title: See the Homecoming Fly-In and static display
cards.subtitle: Homecoming & Family Weekend, Daytona Beach campus
cards.notes: Watch the Homecoming schedule for flight-line access details, then include the fly-in and static-display visit in your weekend itinerary.
cards.short_summary: An aviation-centered Homecoming activity built around aircraft on display.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle’s 2026 Homecoming & Family Weekend page lists participating in the fly-in and touring the static display among prior event highlights.
cards.source_title: Homecoming and Family Weekend 2026 | Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University
cards.access_notes: Listed as a previous Homecoming highlight; confirm whether it returns and review flight-line access instructions for the current year.

cards.title: Make time for Discovery Day
cards.subtitle: Annual student research symposium, Daytona Beach
cards.notes: Browse the virtual exhibit for previous years, then watch university research announcements for the next chance to see student work presented.
cards.short_summary: A recurring campus showcase of student, faculty and staff research and creative work.
cards.evidence_claim: Embry-Riddle’s Discovery Day exhibit describes an annual Daytona Beach Student Research Symposium and archives programs from 2015 through 2025.
cards.source_title: Discovery Day | Embry-Riddle Daytona Beach
cards.access_notes: The exhibit documents prior symposium years; consult the Office of Undergraduate Research for the next event’s presentation details.
